text: So you add a support button.
And there it sits, on every page, every day.
After a while, nobody even sees it anymore.
quietjar gives your button a finish line, like this month's hosting bill.
As people chip in, the bar fills up.
Paying takes just two taps, right on your page, with Apple Pay, iDEAL or a card.
And once the goal is met, the button simply disappears.
Next month, it comes back for the next bill.
There's no monthly fee, just five percent of what you receive.
Ask when it matters. Then go quiet.
